_meta.description: Lattices where at least one size-2 pair of singleton subsets (one concept kept each) produces a Borda-aggregated top-1 tie. Bundled from llama31-8b dataset (halted lattices excluded).
_meta.aggregation: Borda over 2 singletons; each answer scores (M-1-rank) per singleton, summed
_meta.singleton_definition: subset at layer n-1 (one concept kept); n derived from max removal-set size in raw_answers
_meta.tie_definition: top-1 Borda score shared by 2 or more answers
